Subject: MSA & Order Form redlines — confidentiality and announcement language

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for sending the draft MSA and order form. Attached are BlueBay's consolidated redlines (MSA_v3 and OrderForm_redlines). We focused on: confidentiality carveouts for aggregated analytics, limits on publicity (logo use/quotes/case studies), and a proposed two-step approval for joint announcements.

Key BlueBay asks (high level):
- No logo or name use for marketing without prior written approval that attaches the specific asset (logo, quote, case study).
- Embargo window: BlueBay requests a 45-day review period post-contract signature before any public announcement unless a joint press release is agreed.
- Confidentiality: carve out for aggregated telemetry that is de-identified and used for model performance benchmarking.

Can you confirm Redwood's position on the embargo window and the testimony/quote approval workflow? If possible, we'd like to schedule a 30-minute call next week to close these items.

Attachments: BlueBay_MSA_redlines_v3.pdf, BlueBay_OrderForm_Redlines.docx

Regards,
Sarah Connors
Sr. Counsel, BlueBay Health
legal@bluebayhealth.com

Hi Sarah — thanks for the redlines and clear summary. We appreciate the detail.

Quick responses to your bullets:
- Embargo window: Redwood typically operates with a 30-day silent period but is open to a 45-day window for sensitive healthcare customers; we might ask for a narrow exception for co-marketing activity tied to contract start milestones.
- Logo/quote approval: we agree to a written-approval requirement; suggest adding a short SLT turn-around SLA in the SOW (e.g., 7 business days for a response to a specific logo/quote request).
- Aggregated telemetry: we can accept explicit language allowing de-identified aggregated performance metrics provided they cannot be reverse engineered to identify BlueBay data. We'll propose specific redline language for that.

Proposal: let's have a 30-minute call on Tue Nov 7 at 10:00am PT (I can host). If that doesn't work, Wed Nov 8 morning PT. Agenda: agree embargo length, finalize publicity clause language (logo use/approval workflow), and accept/clarify telemetry carveout.

I've attached a short draft clause we use for references and logo use — "Redwood Reference & Asset Use Proposal" — to this thread (uploaded to the drive link below). Marissa, looping you for marketing's POV on the approval SLA and template. Karthik — can you confirm commercial acceptance of the 45-day embargo in exchange for a co-marketing credits clause?

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B_example_drive_link

Thanks,

Sarah / team — quick commercial note from Redwood:

We're fine to accept a 45-day embargo provided the contract includes a modest marketing credit: Redwood will provide a one-time $15k co-marketing credit (to cover joint PR support and design/production) that can be used for a joint announcement or case study. That makes the 45-day window acceptable commercially.

On logos/quotes: we need the ability to reference BlueBay as a customer in sales collateral and short reference lists (one-line mention) prior to a formal case study, provided BlueBay's brand guidelines are followed and assets are pre-approved (7 business days). For any extended use (logo in ads, or screenshots), written approval is required.

If Legal confirms the 45-day embargo and the asset-approval SLA, we can mark the deal as ready for signature pending minor redline reconciliation.

Hi all — from Marketing's side, we'd prefer the following streamlined workflow to reduce back-and-forth when assets are requested: 
- Request: Redwood submits a single assets packet (logo files, draft quote copy, and intended placement/context) via the shared drive link.
- Approval: BlueBay responds within 7 business days with: Approve / Minor edits (inline) / Reject.
- If Minor edits, Redwood returns updated copy within 3 business days for final sign-off.

Template language for the order form SOW: "Customer approvals for logos and quotes will not be unreasonably withheld; Customer will provide written approval or requested edits within seven (7) business days of receipt of a complete assets packet."

We can also accept an initial one-line reference ("BlueBay Health, customer of Redwood Inference") without logo or detailed quote during the embargo if BlueBay prefers — that would help with case qualification for our sales team while protecting BlueBay's public stance.

I'll prep a sample assets packet and upload to the Drive ahead of the call.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Marketing Programs, Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Connors <sarah.connors@bluebayhealth.com>

Date: Tue, 7 Nov 2028 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form redlines — confidentiality and announcement language

Thanks — this is helpful. BlueBay is comfortable with the following compromise:
- 45-day embargo window from effective date for standalone public announcements; joint press release can be published earlier if both parties agree in writing.
- One-line reference permitted during embargo (no logo, no deep-dive metrics).
- Logo and quote use require a completed assets packet and written approval within seven (7) business days. If BlueBay requests edits, Redwood will make reasonable revisions within three (3) business days.
- Aggregated, de-identified telemetry allowed for benchmarking provided the data is presented in aggregate and cannot be used to identify BlueBay's patients or operations; add explicit non-reverse-engineering covenant.

Sarah will circulate an updated redline with these points incorporated by Thursday EOD. After review, Evelyn/Legal can confirm and we can move to signature.

Appreciate the flexibility — speak at the Tue call.

Best,
Sarah
